species_compatibility.reason: Giraffes browse treetops and zebras graze below, so a savanna yard with a tall fence suits both
Elephants can trample zebras when they share a yard

alerts.message: Habitat #1 missed 4 scheduled care jobs in the last day; its animals went without. Add keepers to its zone or lower other priorities.
Juniper (#1) and 1 other animal in habitat #1 may come down with the sniffles: habitat #1 is dirty. Check that its keepers can clean it.

groups.plan: Habitat #1 (Capybara): our favourite species, 7 tiles away, room at the fence

objectives.hint: Choose Draw habitat and drag a rectangle on clear grass with one side along a path, so guests can see in. Bigger habitats hold more animals; the price follows area and fence length. Undo refunds it today.
objectives.title: Fence a habitat

objectives.hint: Keepers walk from the depot along paths and enter through the habitat's service gate, the marked gap in the fence. Move the gate to a fence side along a connected path, or extend the path to the tile just outside it.
objectives.title: Connect the service gate to the path

objectives.hint: A habitat belongs to the work zone that contains its service gate, not its fence. Choose Zones and drag a rectangle around the gate.
objectives.title: Put the service gate in a work zone

objectives.hint: Habitats create care work; keepers accept it. Only keepers assigned to a zone take its habitats' jobs. Hire a keeper at the depot, then assign them in the zone inspector.
objectives.title: Hire a keeper and assign them to the zone

objectives.hint: Feeding jobs take crates from the depot. Without feed, animals go hungry however many keepers you hire. Buy feed crates in the depot inspector.
objectives.title: Stock feed at the depot

objectives.hint: Open the habitat and adopt animals of one species until the social and space scores both read 100: enough to keep each other company, not so many they crowd.
objectives.title: Adopt a suitable social group

objectives.hint: Animals without shelter lose welfare. Add basic shelter in the habitat inspector.
objectives.title: Add a shelter

objectives.hint: Adopting copied the species' care routine into the habitat. Its Care list shows each task's time, interval and when it is next due; each due time becomes one job for the zone's keepers.
objectives.title: See the habitat create care work

objectives.hint: Priorities decide which job goes first when keepers are short and work piles up. Raise or lower one task's priority in the habitat's Care list.
objectives.title: Change one care task's priority

objectives.hint: Guests arrive along paths that pass a stocked habitat's fence and pay admission at the gate. Each viewing spot holds only a few guests, so a crowded fence turns guests away. Let time run.
objectives.title: Welcome your first guests

objectives.hint: Hungry and thirsty guests grow unhappy and leave. A stand beside the path sells to them. Cash rises with admissions and sales and falls with wages, feed and upkeep.
objectives.title: Open a food or drink stand

objectives.hint: A due job waits until a keeper in the zone who accepts its care category and is on shift walks in through the gate. The Care list says why a job is still waiting.
objectives.title: Watch a keeper finish a care job

objectives.hint: Welfare follows social group and space, counted twice, plus food, water, cleanliness and shelter. Keepers restore food, water and cleanliness on schedule; fix the lowest part shown in the inspector.
objectives.title: Raise every habitat's welfare to 70
